experiment_type: exploratory SLA-pattern arm; component ablation follows trace inspection
objective: Test whether restoring explicit Spec-to-Ledger-to-Draft discipline improves the compiler hybrid by making source coverage deliberate before drafting and making deterministic findings actionable afterward.

held_constant.retrieval_surface: H5 coding-native legal scopes and immutable working sets
held_constant.split: visible Harvey LAB dev tasks only

candidate_contract.spec: Turn the instructions into a checklist of every required issue, comparison, calculation, and deliverable field.
candidate_contract.ledger: Gather each material checklist fact into a compact source-addressed working ledger with narrow Grep/Read legal scopes or a bounded cross-document working set; represent missing support as an explicit gap.
candidate_contract.draft: Create the exact requested artifact only after each material checklist item has evidence or an explicit gap.
candidate_contract.audit: Run anchor, arithmetic, temporal, defined-term, structure, and drafting checks automatically after synthesis; these checks are not model-callable tools in this arm.
candidate_contract.grounding: Return bounded typed findings, require exact-span verification, and revise the actual artifact for every grounded material issue while rejecting verified noise rather than blindly copying source-only anchors.

bundled_difference_from_h6: Restores the full explicit SLA reasoning sequence in coding-native terminology.
Hides the document_quality domain and its six callable tools because the same organs run automatically.
Strengthens the correction instruction from an optional-sounding pass to mandatory evaluation of every finding and revision of every material grounded issue.
observations: native LAB score and valid artifact
pre-draft document/span coverage and use of exact legal scopes or working sets
whether drafting begins before material checklist coverage
automatic findings accepted, rejected, or mishandled and whether the artifact is actually revised
tool/domain calls, schemas, source exposure, replay, per-round context bytes, cache tokens, and latency
interpretation_policy: This arm tests the coherent SLA product pattern, not isolated prompt sentences. Attribute no causal component win until later ablations. A result is useful even if aggregate score falls when traces identify whether coverage discipline, compiler noise, or the correction checkpoint caused the change.
failure_policy: Fail closed unless Fast reports priority; retain failures and noisy findings in receipts; do not replace tasks or rerun completed cells to hide behavior.
